nodes.label: CPD MVP attendance-verified issuance build (8-stage plan)
nodes.rationale: Ivan asked for the actual CPD MVP loop -- create -> publish -> attend -> feedback -> CPD logged, end-to-end functional, with accreditation deferred. Executed as an Ivan-approved 8-stage plan after two rounds of external review were folded into the execution-plan doc.

nodes.label: award_attendance_credit() SECURITY DEFINER function
nodes.rationale: Identity resolution had to live inside the definer because public.users has no email column -- the definer can read auth.users, the TypeScript layer cannot.

nodes.label: credit_ledger_attendance_uniq idempotency partial index
nodes.rationale: Originally keyed on entry_type='attendance', a value the CHECK constraint never allowed, so the index was silently inert. Re-keyed to entry_type='credit_earned' AND attestation_status='attendance_verified'. It is what makes repeated reconcile runs a safe no-op.

nodes.label: scripts/cpd/reconcile-event.ts recovery path
nodes.rationale: Re-calls awardAttendanceCredit for every attended registration unconditionally -- safe only because the Stage 1 idempotency index makes repeats a no-op. Needed a Node module-cache stub before a dynamic import to survive the helper's `import 'server-only'` outside Next's build pipeline.

nodes.label: CPD_ISSUANCE_ENABLED kill switch (fail-open)
nodes.rationale: Originally required an explicit 'true' that nothing set anywhere, so every award silently skipped with nothing logged -- a Hard Rule 12 violation. Inverted to fail-open ('false' disables), skip-log added, regression test added.

nodes.label: Four schema mismatches caught by the build itself
nodes.rationale: Neither the plan nor either external review round caught them: the non-existent entry_type='attendance', the missing 'attendance_verified' CHECK value, public.users having no email column, and practitioner_licences.status using 'verified' rather than 'active'.

nodes.label: attendance_verified attestation tier
nodes.rationale: Widened into the attestation_status CHECK with Ivan's confirmation because venue-captured attendance is a distinct, stronger provenance tier than organiser_attested.

nodes.label: Static gates miss what live drives catch
nodes.rationale: Every stage touching a live user-facing or operational flow had at least one real bug that tsc/eslint/vitest/next-build passed straight over -- Stage 4's wrong-Supabase-project and kill-switch bugs, Stage 6's miss/re-run proof. Named the load-bearing lesson of the whole build.

nodes.label: Standing usage-credit pause instruction
nodes.rationale: Ivan: 'do not use my credit unless i ask you too' -- Claude/API usage credit, not money. Standing for this and future sessions: stop at the rolling window rather than enter paid overage. The session paused cleanly, not because anything broke.

nodes.label: No automated resume mechanism exists
nodes.rationale: The only wake-up mechanism is scoped to /loop dynamic mode, and cloud routines run as fully isolated agents with a fresh clone of what is already pushed -- they cannot see local uncommitted work nor reach the local Supabase/Docker stack the live verification depends on. A routine was deliberately NOT created; the handoff doc is the resume path.

nodes.label: NewEventForm.test.tsx concurrency flake
nodes.rationale: Always 21/21 in isolation, zero diff from CPD-build work. Promotion threshold set here: fix it if a third occurrence lands.

nodes.label: tests/cpd/attendance_issuance.rls.test.ts
nodes.rationale: Covers issue, idempotency, a real Promise.all race (not a simulated one), and the guards.

nodes.label: docs/DEFERRED.md backlog register
nodes.rationale: Holds the Full-product scope the MVP deliberately left out, each row already pointed at a native or already-installed target so no new dependency is implied by re-entry.

nodes.label: /Users/ivan/Eventar-demo worktree
nodes.rationale: Was manually patched with copied files mid-build; needs `git checkout --detach main` to pick up genuinely-committed work rather than continuing hand-copying.
